summary: Federal Communications Commission urged to preserve E-Rate program to support schools and libraries in maintaining essential broadband infrastructure for modern education and student success. The comments urge protection of the E-Rate program to ensure educational access for students, emphasizing the importance of connectivity in an increasingly technology-driven economy.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would have direct and tangible impact on school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: Our budgets are taking a beating with health insurance costs rising 34.4%, uncontrolled cost escalation for any facilities work, expanding needs for special education and more. We desperately need help. Those costs would ultimately compete with the resources we use to support students and educators.

claims.argument: The FCC should protect E-Rate to ensure public schools maintain connectivity for students.
claims.evidence_quote: Our students deserve access to the tools they need to learn and succeed regardless of where they live or their family’s financial circumstances.
